today.noPathwayBody: A pathway is a short, guided series of lessons. You can change your mind at any time.
today.allDoneBody: That's enough for now. When you want more, there are other pathways waiting.
today.readingBody: Read the passage from today's lesson in the Bible first, if you like.
today.reflectionBody: Write a few honest lines about what you're learning. It stays private unless you choose to share it.
today.versesBody: {count, plural, one {# verse is} other {# verses are}} ready to review whenever you are.
today.noMentorBody: A mentor can read what you choose to share and write back. Ask your organisation's admin to match you with someone.
today.soloBody: Everything here works without a church or group. When you're ready, you can join an organisation and invite a mentor.
today.title: Today
today.dayCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing recorded} one {# item} other {# items}}
today.reflectionShort: Write a few honest lines. Private unless you share it.
today.emptyDraft: An empty page, ready when you are.
today.noReflections: Your reflections will appear here after your first lesson.
today.promoBody: Questions about a passage? Ask, and get a clear, labelled answer.
today.noActivity: Your recent steps will show here.

journey.title: Your journey
journey.description: Where you've been, where you are, and what's ahead.
journey.noneBody: Choose one below to start. You can change at any time.
journey.allEnrolled: You're already on every available pathway.

pathway.draftNotice: This pathway is a draft. Only its author can see it.

lesson.empty: This lesson has no content yet.
lesson.doneBody: Well done. Your progress is saved.
lesson.pathwayDoneBody: You have reached the end of “{pathway}”. Take a moment to notice how far you've come.

audio.title: Listen to this lesson
audio.length: About {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}
audio.voiceNote: Read aloud by your device's own voice.

quiz.title: Check your understanding
quiz.lookAgain: Let's look at that one again.

reflect.newBody: Write what is on your mind. Nothing is shared unless you choose.
reflect.saveError: Couldn't save yet. Your words are still here; we'll try again.
reflect.conflict: This entry changed somewhere else. Reload to see the latest version.
reflect.mentorHelp: They can read it and write back. You can make it private again.
reflect.mentorNone: You don't have a mentor yet, so you can't share with one.
reflect.groupHelp: Members of your group can read it and reply.
reflect.groupNone: You aren't in a group yet.
reflect.sharedMentor: {mentor} can now read this and write back. You'll be notified when they do.
reflect.sharedGroup: Your group, {group}, can now read this.
reflect.savedPrivate: Saved to your journal. Only you can read it.
reflect.noRepliesPrivate: This entry is private. Share it with your mentor if you'd like a reply.
reflect.noRepliesDraft: Share this entry when you're ready, and your mentor can reply.
reflect.noRepliesYet: No reply yet. Your mentor will be notified and can write back when they're ready.
reflect.deleteBody: It will be removed from your journal and from anyone you shared it with.

journal.title: Journal
journal.description: Everything you've written, linked to the lessons that prompted it.
journal.emptyBody: When you write a reflection it's kept here, linked to the lesson that prompted it.
journal.noMatchBody: Try a different word or clear the filters.

timeline.emptyBody: As you read, write and meet with others, the moments that matter will gather here.

milestones.intro: Milestones mark moments that matter. There are no scores here, and nothing to catch up on.
milestones.noneBody: They'll appear as you go. The first one is usually finishing a lesson.

goals.title: Goals
goals.newHelp: Something small and specific that you'd like to do.
goals.none: No goals yet. A small one is a good start.
